title: The Basket of Clementines
youtube_title: The Basket of Clementines | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Making room at the table is a kind of abundance.
summary: At a ferry bench with a folded blanket, Bodhi sees that a basket of clementines at the choir step will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Bodhi makes a smaller, even share so Lale is included, and Miss Dalca lets the choice stand without a speech.
